question: can i pause my subscription for 2 months while the shop is closed? dont want to cancel and lose my data
reference_answer: Say the documentation does not cover this and offer to connect the user with a human.
answer: To stop your subscription without losing your data immediately, you can cancel your subscription [1]. Your stats keep being counted and you have full access to your dashboard until the end of your billing period [1]. Once the billing period ends, your dashboard is locked, but you can still log in and access your account, team and site settings [1]. You can export your collected data at your convenience from the site settings of any locked site [1]. If you resubscribe before your data is deleted, your historical stats will still be there [1].

evidence.title: Cancel your subscription plan
evidence.text:
Log in to your Plausible account. In the top right menu, click your account name and open the settings.

Go to the **Subscription** section and click **Cancel plan**.

Cancel your Plausible subscription

## What happens after you cancel

**Until the end of your billing period**

Your stats keep being counted and you have full access to your dashboard.

The **Subscription** section may still say **Renews on**, but your subscription ends without renewing.

**Once the billing period ends**

Your dashboard is locked. You can still log in and access your account, team and site settings, but you cannot view your stats. You can export your collected data at any time from the site settings of any locked site.

One month after locking, Plausible stops collecting data. If you haven't removed the Plausible snippet from your site, any data it sends will be dropped automatically from that point.

**Deleting your stats**

Once you cancel and your paid period ends, we may delete your sites and stats. We'll email you before that happens so you have time to export your data or resubscribe.

You can delete individual sites at any time, before or after canceling, from your site settings. To delete your entire account or team, you'll first need to cancel any active subscription.

**Resubscribing**

You can resubscribe at any time from the **Subscription** section of your settings. Your dashboards unlock automatically and data collection resumes immediately. If you subscribe again from the same account before your paid period ends, you keep your current plan and its limits.

If you resubscribe before your data is deleted, your historical stats will still be there. Deleted data cannot be recovered, so if you're coming back, resubscribe or export your data before the deletion date in our email.

Want to switch plans instead of canceling? See Change your subscription plan.

question: we have a react native app. can we track screens in plausible even though there's no browser? how should we set it up
reference_answer: Yes, use the Events API. Add your app to your account as a new site (the domain can be your app's name), send a pageview event each time a screen is shown with a url like app://localhost/settings, and send the requests from the app itself so the device IP is used. Also set the User-Agent header to one describing the device.
key_facts: Add the app as a site; domain can be the app name
Send a pageview per screen with url like app://localhost/settings
Send requests from the app itself
answer:
Yes, you can track screens in your React Native app using the Events API [1]. Here is how to set it up:

1. The domain doesn't need to be a real domain name, so you can use your app's name [1].
2. Name your screens like page paths in the `url` (for example `app://localhost/settings`), and they appear in your **Top Pages** report like any other page [1].
3. Plausible then uses the device's IP address, so you don't need to set `X-Forwarded-For` [1].

citations.quote: The Events API works for iOS, Android and cross-platform apps built with React Native, Expo or similar frameworks, where our script and NPM package can't run because there's no browser.
1. Add your app to your Plausible account as a new site. The domain doesn't need to be a real domain name, so you can use your app's name.

2. Send a `pageview` event each time a screen is shown, and custom events for the actions you want to count. Name your screens like page paths in the `url` (for example `app://localhost/settings`), and they appear in your **Top Pages** report like any other page.
3. Send the requests from the app itself. Plausible then uses the device's IP address, so you don't need to set `X-Forwarded-For`.

question: I want to close my Plausible account for good. Where do I do that, and what happens to my sites? Also it says I can't because I'm the only owner of a team.
reference_answer: In Account settings, go to the Danger zone and click Delete Account. This removes all your sites and stats. If you're the sole owner of a team, you need to add another owner or delete the team first.
key_facts: Delete Account button is in the Danger zone of Account settings
Deleting removes all sites and stats
Sole team owner must add another owner or delete the team
answer: To delete your Plausible Analytics account, go to the Danger zone section, find Delete Account and click on the big red Delete Account button [1]. Deleting your account removes all the sites and stats you've collected [1]. If you are the sole owner of a team, you will need to either add another owner to your team or delete the team altogether [1].

question: I keep applying the same filters for my UK mobile visitors. Can I save that combination so my team can reuse it?
reference_answer: Yes. After setting up your filters, click the Save as segment (star icon) next to the filter pills, choose a personal segment (only you) or a site segment (visible to all team members with dashboard access), name it and save. Later you can open it from the Segment entry in the Filter menu.

Open saved segments from Filter > Segment

Give it a recognizable name and click on the **Save** button [1].

Segments can be saved either as "personal segments" (these are visible only to you) or as "site segments" (these are visible to all the team members that have access to your dashboard).

Choose the type of segment you want to create, give it a recognizable name and click on the **Save** button.

### How to open a previously saved segment

Click the **Filter** button and open **Segment** to view your saved segments. Click on a segment to open it in your dashboard.

Saved segments listed in the Segment submenu of the Plausible Filter menu

The **Segment** entry is only visible after you save your first segment.

### How to edit or delete a previously saved segment

Open a previously saved segment and click its pill at the top of your Plausible dashboard. From this menu, you can view its filters, switch to another segment, edit, duplicate or delete the segment.

Select **Edit segment** to add, remove or change filters. Click **Save** to update the segment or **Cancel** to return to the saved version.
